incidents.rootCause: Deleting legacy-payment-handler severed an undocumented invocation from fraud-detection-service. Fraud checks failed open for 17 minutes — all transactions were allowed without screening. Redeployment resolved.

Memory reduced from 1024 MB to 256 MB caused OOM errors under concurrent checkout load during a flash sale. checkout-service-lambda processes cart and payment state in-memory; insufficient memory caused Lambda to crash under peak concurrency.

Parameter group change reduced max_connections from 200 to 50. payment-processor-lambda (48k req/day) and reporting-lambda both hold connection pools. Under peak load, connections exhausted, causing FATAL: sorry, too many clients already errors.
